description:
Nothing downstream works without this. The TUAS solid database currently holds only copper, stainless, fibreglass, aerogel, FeCrAl and a generic heating element. There is no graphite anywhere in the workspace.

SCOPE: matrix-grade and reflector-grade nuclear graphite with density, specific heat capacity and thermal conductivity as functions of temperature, plus conductivity degradation with fast-neutron dose. Dose dependence matters because irradiated reflector conductivity falls substantially and that changes the passive decay-heat path.

uom-typed, doc comments stating the valid temperature and dose range of every correlation, and the source of each correlation cited with provenance per DATA_POLICY.md. Open published property data only.

Blocks: pebble-bed effective conductivity, radial pebble conduction, the reflector/cavity path.
title: HTR-10: graphite properties in the solid material database
